themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Covers AI agents performing research tasks autonomously or semi-autonomously, including agents for data analysis, task execution, and decision-making.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Focuses on AI tools that assist developers in writing, debugging, and reviewing code, including AI agents that can write code.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Encompasses a broad category of AI-powered platforms and software designed to assist researchers in various aspects of their work, from data collection to analysis.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Explores the use of AI-generated personas or simulated users for testing, research, and understanding user behavior without human involvement.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Deals with AI's capability to condense large amounts of text or data into concise summaries, useful for research reports and meeting insights.

themes.name: AI-powered data analysis
themes.description: Covers AI applications used to analyze datasets, identify patterns, and derive insights, particularly in quantitative UX research.

themes.name: AI content generation
themes.description: Focuses on AI's ability to create various forms of content, including text, images, and video, often used in design and marketing.

themes.name: AI conversational agents
themes.description: Includes research and discussions around chatbots and other conversational AI interfaces used for user interaction and information retrieval.

themes.name: AI research tools comparison
themes.description: Articles that compare the performance, features, and effectiveness of different AI tools used for research purposes.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Examines how AI is affecting jobs, skills, and the overall workforce, including recruitment and the changing nature of work.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
